start: Admin app signed in as owner; HQ sent two messages to every gym this month

steps.action: Tap the bell at the top
user_sees: The bell opens with the group "From MettleUp"
The two HQ messages, newest first, each with title, words and its link
must_not: Another gym's own notices in "From MettleUp"
An error in place of the list

user_sees: The page the message points to opens
must_not: A broken or empty link opened

start: Admin app; HQ never sent a message, or the HQ messages table is not there yet

user_sees: No "From MettleUp" lines; the rest of the bell as usual
must_not: A red error
An endless spinner in the bell

start: Admin app; a message from HQ shows in the bell

steps.action: HQ takes the message down; wait a minute and open the bell again
must_not: The removed message still shown after a minute
Other HQ messages gone with it
Messages older than 120 days in the bell

steps.action: Open the bell in each gym
user_sees: The same "From MettleUp" messages in both
must_not: Anything of one gym shown to another
A message that names a gym or a member
